best_reproduced.provenance: The public coordinate text was copied locally and translated from the centered unit square to [0,1]^2. The published decimal coordinates were retained. The common radius was reduced from 0.096362339010 to 0.09636233900 to account conservatively for coordinate rounding.
best_reproduced.ai_provenance: Coordinate transcription, translation, radius reduction, and exact rational verification performed for this task; the construction is attributed to Nurmela and Östergård (1999).
best_reproduced.evidence_state: local witness checked against exact rational boundary and pair-distance constraints

survey_scope_note: Best public means the strongest same-parameter result in the cited checked sources. This is not a claim that every public source has been surveyed. Unmatched parameters are listed separately.
frozen_human_baseline_type: published human witness or explicit construction formula
